verdicts.reason: Both candidates are essentially the same broken layout and both score 1. The hero photo of praying hands is gone except for a black sliver at the top centre and a hard black vertical bar down the middle. The white crosses and cloud shapes now sit on a white background, so they read as faint grey ghosts in the empty left half. Only the quote and attribution survive, crammed to the right, so the design no longer looks like the original. The only difference is that the 'MAHATMA GANDHI' tracking is very slightly tighter in B, which changes nothing.
